title: The local and adjunct normalization equations and four-step transport predicate
statement: For UniformizerChernNormalizationData l Y [def-diagonal-uniformizer-chern-transport], LocalNormalized(s,theta,z) is the equality between restriction of z followed by its shifted line-limit comparison and coefficientsX.unitMap followed by LX of restrictionX(theta) [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-coefficients]. AdjunctNormalized(s,c) is exactly restriction of c followed by sourceMap equal to coefficientsS.unitMap followed by LS(systemChern), using the actual model.chernAdjoint, without re-elaborating its shift instance [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-presentation, def-sp-tower-class-chern]. For an abstract ChernCoefficientDiagram x, completed arrow c and final finite arrow w, TransportTo(x,c,w) is fourStepChernCommutes with the same four functors and eight endpoints as x.Commutes [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-reference, def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-scalars, def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-finite-realization, lem-diagonal-finite-trace-chern-criterion]. NormalizedAdjunctPair(s) stores z,c, LocalNormalized for theta=firstChern(O(1)), and AdjunctNormalized(s,c). Its Transported predicate is TransportTo for c and the ordinary finite adjunct of localUnitInv followed by localFunctor(z) followed by localLine [def-diagonal-uniformizer-local-endpoints]. All are explicit formulas and supplied fields, with no asserted transport equation or chosen witness.

proof.text: Name the local root-limit equality, and retain the canonical systemChern normalization as given in the input record. Define the fourfold arrow equation at abstract coefficients. Package z,c and their given normalization proofs in a structure; name its finite-adjunct transport equation. These definitions assert no equation and choose no data.
